about.headline: Outdoor living and renos, built properly.
about.body: Most people want the same things from a builder: someone licensed, a clear price before work starts, good communication and a site left spotless. Every job runs that way, from verandah lattice to a full outdoor entertaining area.

realReviews.author: Jodie Murray
realReviews.text:
Morgan and his team are very professional, timely delivery, excellent products, great communication, and respectful of our home.
We were thrilled with the service and final product. Morgan was able to adapt and add on changes at our request.
We highly recommend Morgan for any Carpentary jobs/building

realReviews.author: Caroline Jones
realReviews.text: Morgan and his team at MJS Carpentry did an absolutely fantastic job at installing the lattice and door on our Queenslander front verandah. His attention to detail was excellent. He communicated well along the way and left the verandah spotless! We are so impressed we’d like to offer him future work on our ‘never-ending restoration project’ :)) I highly recommend his services! You won’t be disappointed!

realReviews.author: Sarah Webb
realReviews.text: Highly recommend MJS Carpentry! They were incredibly helpful, kind, and professional throughout the process. The work on my deck was amazing, everything was done efficiently, and communication was excellent. Really respectful, informative, and easy to deal with… couldn’t be happier with the results!

finalCta.headline: Ready to talk about your deck, pergola or reno?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a free quote before anything is booked in.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward chat about the job.

faq.a: Yes. Send the job through the form or give Morgan a ring, and you'll get a written quote before any work starts.
Yes. MJS Carpentry holds QBCC licence 15512539 and is fully insured.
Samford Valley and greater Brisbane, including Chermside, North Lakes, Redcliffe, Caboolture, Ipswich and Cleveland. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can I make changes once the job starts?
faq.a: Yes. Changes are talked through and added on request, so the finished job matches what you want.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book a site visit.
